findings.claim: The India online food delivery market stands at USD 55.58 billion, growing at a 22.18% compound annual growth rate through 2034.
findings.evidence: India has quietly become the most disruptive food delivery market on the planet. Not the largest by GMV that’s China but by innovation velocity, platform intensity, and the sheer density of competition at every level from restaurant aggregation to 10-minute grocery delivery. In 2026, the India online food delivery market stands at USD 55.58 billion, growing at a 22.18% compound annual growth rate through 2034, the fastest-growing food delivery market in the world, and one that consistently produces innovations that later appear in Western markets years later.

findings.evidence: That shift matters because the sector sits at the intersection of changing consumer habits and tightening unit economics.
